title: AI catalog lock
description: Resolved selection lock (.ai/ai.lock.json). Records, per selected item, the source revision, install path and content hash so drift is detectable offline without diffing against upstream. This file is the only thing upgrade logic trusts.

lockVersion.description: Lock format version. Only 1 is produced or understood in Phase 0.

entry.description: One resolved item: where it came from, where it lives, and the hash it must have.

id.description: Selection id in 'source:name' form. Unique together with 'kind' (a skill and an agent may share a name).

kind.description: Item kind, part of the entry's identity. Optional only so older lock files stay readable; catalog.py always writes it.

source.description: Catalog source the item was resolved from ('template' or a third-party source id). Provenance for the copy on disk.

ref.description: Pinned source revision the item was resolved at (copied from the manifest).

path.description: Install path relative to the project root, POSIX separators (e.g. '.ai/skills/council'). The only paths prune is ever allowed to delete.

sha256.description: Item hash recorded at materialisation time: sha256 over the sorted '<relpath>\u0000<content-sha256>' lines of the item's files, excluding markers and __pycache__.

files.description: Number of files the recorded hash covers.

license.description: License of the item content at resolution time (MIT for the template source).

materialize.description: How the item was placed on disk. A change of mode makes sync re-materialise the item.
